acceptanceCriteria: Owner decision recorded: either amend decision 0383 and MCPV0-028 with the new class plus tests, or record that the existing classes stay.
body: Raised by V1-0349 (batch L, 2026-10-08). Over a partial clone, MCP refusals caused by missing promisor objects surface as repository-unavailable, cem-map-unavailable or flows-refused. A distinct reasonClass would tell clients the repository needs its objects fetched. MCPV0-028 is a closed set, so adding one needs an amendment to decision 0383; that is an owner decision.

completion.reason: Decision 0544 item 3 (docs/decisions/0544-one-zero-owner-delegated-dispositions-2026-10-20.md, sha256 evidence digest; landed on main via batch #1277 merge 4987b7ed9): closed MCPV0-028 reasonClass set unchanged, decision 0383 amendment declined, any future promisor signal is a closed code per V1-1427; closed with no code change.

title: Should MCP gain a promisor-specific reasonClass for partial-clone refusals?
